user_query: I'm planning a trip to Europe and I want to communicate with the locals in their native languages. Can you give me a list of languages spoken in different European countries? Also, recommend an API that can help me with pronunciation.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of languages spoken in various European countries.
Search for an API that provides pronunciation information for different languages.
Compile the list of languages with their respective countries along with the pronunciation features from the recommended API.
